results.answer:
Properly stored honey remains edible for a long time primarily because it has low water activity, which limits microbial growth. [Honey and water activity](<https://foodscience.example/honey-storage>)
Additionally, the acidity of honey further inhibits microbial growth during storage. [Honey acidity](<https://beekeeping.test/honey-acidity>)
